Overdue segment shows task cards, no summary line. /touchpoints?view=upcoming and ?view=overdue deep-links select the correct segment. Hub search finds both. Add Contact (/contact/new): initial view shows only First name/Last name/Mobile/Record a voice note (gold)/More details/Save; Save is disabled until first+mobile filled (aria-disabled true -> null after fill). Toggling 'More details' reveals email/vehicle/referral/notes/tags/address/dates/photo and toggle text becomes 'Fewer details'. Duplicate-match-banner still fires. Created contact QA Simplify / 5005550199 -> POST /api/contacts/{uid} succeeded and landed on /contact/6ab09181f62c0bcd7121c918; deleted via DELETE /api/contacts/{uid}/{cid} (status 200). Contacts tab: avatar-button + contacts-view-switch/contacts/recent; tapping Recent shows contacts-recent-feed. Inbox tab: avatar-button present, chips Needs You/All/Jessi/Closed render, gold + FAB visible. Jessi tab (/jessi): avatar-button on left. Jessi floating bar NOT rendered on the 5 tab screens (verified on /home, /jessi, /inbox, /touchpoints); IS available on /more inner screen. Rep login (activation-tester): 5 tabs, Home hero + Your 3 render; avatar sheet has ONLY profile/numbers/va/notifications/settings + tools(label 'More tools')/help/legal/sign-out (no MANAGE/ACCOUNT/INTERNAL). Rep tasks segments render. Rep /more shows the tools grid (this rep has partner_id so gets full hub, not the 3-core simpleTools view — code path is by design).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid={...} prop is NOT emitted to the DOM for React Native Web TextInput/TouchableOpacity, so input-first-name, input-last-name, input-phone, new-contact-more-details, new-contact-cancel, new-contact-header, new-contact-photo, input-email, input-vehicle, new-contact-referral, input-notes, new-contact-add-tag, input-address-street/city/state/zip, new-contact-date-birthday/anniversary/date_sold, duplicate-match-banner, import-phone-contact-btn cannot be queried via [data-testid=...]. Only PrimaryButton-based buttons (new-contact-voice-btn, new-contact-done) render the attribute because PrimaryButton uses the spread pattern. Same RN-Web pass-through bug reported in iter342 for sold-quick — please switch to `testID="x" {...({ 'data-testid': 'x' } as any)}` pattern on TextInput/TouchableOpacity, or add a global babel-plugin that maps testID→data-testid.

Segment label reads 'Overdue 42' but GET /api/tasks/{uid}/summary returns overdue=38 (pending_today=42). The tab badge correctly uses .overdue (=38) so those two numbers disagree in the UI: red '38' in the bottom bar vs '42' inside the Overdue chip and the 'OVERDUE · 42' section header. The in-list overdue count appears to be derived from the local filtered task array (pending_today) rather than summary.overdue. Not strictly a spec violation (spec only pins the tab BADGE to summary.overdue), but it's confusing that Home 'Clear 38 overdue tasks' + tab badge = 38 while the Tasks screen shows 42 overdue. Consider using summary.overdue for touchpoints-count-overdue and the OVERDUE section label.

action_items: Fix RN-Web data-testid pass-through on TextInput and TouchableOpacity in app/contact/new.tsx (same fix as iter342 sold-quick): use `testID="foo" {...({ 'data-testid': 'foo' } as any)}` OR install a global babel plugin. Affects ~20 testids on Add Contact and blocks automated FE testing on that flow.
Reconcile touchpoints-count-overdue (currently reads pending_today=42) with summary.overdue=38 so Home's 'Clear N overdue tasks' + tab badge + Tasks segment all show the same number.

Consider removing/hiding the empty coming-up count zero state and the very long tag_history returned by /api/auth/me (payload was ~90KB of at_risk/dormant tag flips) — pagination or archival would help mobile bandwidth.
critical_code_review_comments: React Native Web quirk: `data-testid` on TextInput/TouchableOpacity is silently dropped unless spread onto the underlying host element. This has been reported for TWO iterations in a row (iter342 sold-quick, iter344 contact/new). Recommend a codemod that converts `data-testid="..."` on TextInput/TouchableOpacity to the spread pattern, or global babel plugin. Otherwise every new screen will keep introducing untestable inputs.
app/(tabs)/touchpoints.tsx: the count shown in Overdue segment should probably use tasksSummary.overdue for parity with the Home hero and tab badge — right now it derives from filtered list length.

components/home/NeedsYouStrip.tsx renders needs-you-open-inbox as a link — good; verify it uses in-app router.push('/inbox') to avoid the static marketing page shadowing (agent context noted /inbox direct load is shadowed on web).
/api/auth/me tag_history array is unbounded and dominates payload — consider capping to last 20 entries.

context_for_next_testing_agent: React Native Web strips data-testid on TextInput/TouchableOpacity unless the spread pattern is used. On Add Contact use placeholders ('First name','Last name','Mobile','Email') to fill inputs and text matches ('More details'/'Fewer details') to toggle sections until E1 fixes this. Login POSTs /api/auth/login and sets an httpOnly session cookie; /api/auth/me returns { token, user }, use user._id for /api/tasks/{uid}/summary. In-app nav via history.pushState + PopStateEvent works reliably (page.goto('/inbox') is shadowed by the marketing page).
rca of the issue: (1) Add Contact untestable testids -> React Native Web's TextInput/TouchableOpacity does not forward `data-testid`; the components pass unknown props to the underlying host element via ...rest, but the RNW build in this repo drops testID → data-testid unless the spread trick is used. Fix per PrimaryButton (already uses testID + spread). (2) touchpoints-count-overdue = 42 vs summary.overdue = 38 -> the Tasks screen counts overdue from the today list (which contains 42 pending items including overdue) instead of consuming tasksSummary.overdue. Fix: `const overdueCount = summary?.overdue ?? overdueItems.length;`.
